historical_version_evidence.meaning: Saved old build installed0.2.8; not fresh CPU or runtime admission.

sources.finding: Public StructuredOutputsParams(json=...) is passed through SamplingParams. Exactly one constraint kind; no old guided_decoding API.
LLM accepts structured_outputs_config dictionary and builds StructuredOutputsConfig.
Explicit xgrammar backend avoids auto selection. disable_additional_properties supports guidance only; use schema additionalProperties:false instead. No reasoning parser is selected.
JSON constraints are validated and compiled; tokenizer metadata uses model vocab_size. CPU preflight calls exact validation and actual tokenizer compilation, but GPU compiler cache is separate.
No reasoner means grammar masking applies; explicit enable_in_reasoning also prevents any configured reasoning exemption. GPU neutral calls warm the same actual schema before scored resets.
GrammarCompiler accepts actual tokenizer metadata, fixed JSON schema, any_whitespace=True and finite cache_limit_bytes. Cache cap is not complete process RSS.
accept_string alone only establishes accepted prefix. Tests require is_completed and is_terminated with terminate_without_stop_token, and separately accept actual cached-tokenizer tokens.

Bounded-string generation excludes escaped quotes/backslashes and pattern handling can ignore length. Schema uses plain JSON strings; original parser independently enforces length and ASCII. No universal parser-equivalence claim.

local_tools.jsonschema_tests: Executed offline; not actual backend compilation

backend_preflight: Future once source-specific CPU phase must pass29 fixed synthetic whole-string and token-matcher cases before GPU; failed rows persist without retry.
limits: Grammar may still produce incomplete output at token/time limit or semantically invalid targets/strings/batches. Strict original parser and native reward remain unchanged. No original failed result is repaired or rescored.
